ticks.note: Tick 1 enters the chart: `volume` and `full` get their initial values, and the local `fills`, which has none, starts at 0. `CAPACITY` is a constant, so it is not in the list of values at all. Both transitions are delayed, so nothing else happens.
`flow` is still 100. `volume + flow` is 100, below `CAPACITY`, so priority 1 fails and the self-loop adds `flow`: `volume` is 100 and `fills` is 1.
`volume + flow` would be 550, which reaches `CAPACITY`, so priority 1 fires: `volume` is set to 500, `full` to true, and the chart enters the final state `Full` and terminates.
The chart has terminated: nothing changes any more.
